role: Homograph/mispronunciation layer for AVSpeech: strips AI-authored [[word|IPA]] markup for display, expands US ZIP codes to spaced digits, and builds an NSAttributedString with .accessibilitySpeechIPANotation hints plus same-length respellings ('live'->'lyve') for TTS.
types: PhoneticOverrides.Hint: struct — NSRange in resolved text + IPA + Source(authored|domain)
toplevel: Static lets: markupPattern `\[\[([^|\]]+)\|([^\]]+)\]\]` and three DomainRules for 'live' (live+measurement noun; your/you're/going/right now.../currently + live not followed by a location preposition; live now/view/screen/tracking/recording), each with ipa laɪv and respelling 'lyve'. The ZIP and 'live' passes are English-only (english: false skips them).

units.does: Returns text with every [[word|IPA]] markup replaced by its word (regex replace with $1); domain rules and ZIP expansion are not applied.

Builds the AVSpeech NSAttributedString: resolve(text, english:) then adds .accessibilitySpeechIPANotation for every hint whose range is valid for the resolved string (isApplicable). english: false skips the English-only passes in resolve.

branches.cond: for each hint that passes isApplicable
branches.effect: adds the IPA attribute; invalid ranges skipped (logged by isApplicable)

units.does: Bounds check for a hint NSRange against the attributed string length: rejects NSNotFound, negative, zero-length, or past-end ranges (logs a warning) so addAttribute cannot raise an ObjC exception.

branches.cond: range location valid, length>0, and location+length <= attrLength
branches.effect: true: returns true; false: debugLog warning with range/source and returns false (hint dropped)

units.does: Returns the display-safe plain text and IPA hints tied to it: in English, ZIP codes are expanded to spaced digits first (expandZipCodes), AI markup is stripped and recorded (stripAuthoredMarkup), then each 'live' domain rule is applied; with english: false only the AI markup is stripped and recorded (no 'dash' or 'lyve' written into a non-English utterance).

branches.effect: ZIPs expanded before markup stripping; else input as is
returns after markup stripping

branches.effect: false (never for this constant pattern): returns (input, []) unchanged

branches.effect: false: continue (no respelling, no hint); true: respell + append domain hint

units.does: Runs two ZIP regexes in order over the text: explicit context ('zip', 'zip code', 'postal code' + 5 digits, optional -4) and a real US state/territory code (AL…WY, DC, PR, GU, VI, AS, MP — not any two capitals, so 'HR 12000' is left alone) + 5 digits; each match's digits become space-separated ('6 2 7 0 4', ZIP+4 as '... dash 1 2 3 4').

branches.cond: for each of the two patterns
branches.effect: explicit pattern first; state pattern second (already-expanded ZIPs no longer match \d{5})

units.does: Compiles a ZIP pattern, iterates matches right-to-left and replaces each with the zipReplacement span/text; returns the rewritten string.

branches.effect: false: returns text unchanged

units.does: For a ZIP match (both patterns have three groups: run-up, ZIP, optional '-dddd') returns (range, spaced digits) for group 2; if group 3 matched with length 5, returns the combined range with 'spaced dash spaced-suffix'.

branches.cond: group 2 found, exactly 5 chars, in bounds
branches.effect: false: nil
